'''Samsam''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was a friend to [[Bant'ena Fhernan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As Bant'ena was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatists]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Samsam was used as leverage against Bant'ena under [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd's]] command. However, he was shot by a Separatist [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] while [[power-gliding]] along the shore of [[Lake Radu]].
